Added `Divine Dog: Totality`, which the bank had only as a stray alias string on `Divine Dogs`: it is its own page, `type = Shikigami`, `user = Megumi Fushiguro Sukuna`, and the `Megumi Fushiguro` page lists it as a separate bolded entry beside Divine Dogs -- the same prefix pair jjk-char-03 and jjk-char-05 already treat as two abilities. The eight that remain are exactly the `type = Shikigami` pages whose `user` fact names Megumi, and exactly what his page enumerates. Now agrees item-for-item with jjk-set-11. `Round Deer` and `Piercing Ox` remain gold on `jjk-char-05`, `Every ability of Sukuna`, where they belong.

questions.question: Every cursed technique of Yuta Okkotsu
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu
questions.note: Added 2026-08-04. Corrected 2026-08-17: `Pure Love` removed. It was never a technique of Yuta's; the engine was right to return four. The string `Pure Love` does not occur once in the `Yuta Okkotsu` page's raw wikitext, and his `=== [[Cursed Technique]]s ===` section names Rika, Complete Manifestation, Copy, Cursed Speech, Shikigami, Sky Manipulation, Thin Ice Breaker, Technique Extinguishment, Maximum Output: Jacob's Ladder, G Warstaff, Shrine, Brain Transplant, Limitless, Infinity, Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue, Hollow Technique: Purple, Reverse Cursed Technique, Authentic Mutual Love and Unlimited Void -- no Pure Love among them. Where the phrase does appear it belongs to someone else or to nobody: the `Rika Orimoto` page gives the Jujutsu Kaisen 0 finisher the heading `Cursed Energy Blast`, tags it `(Unnamed)`, describes it as `an energy beam of "Pure Love", the strongest curse of all` fired by Rika, and attributes the beam to her; the `Yuta Okkotsu vs. Suguru Geto` and `Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis` pages use it only as Yuta's line of dialogue answering Geto's `womanizer` taunt. The only place `Pure Love` is a proper-noun technique on this wiki is `Private Pure Love Train`, Kinji Hakari's `type = Innate Technique`, plus the pachinko manga it is named after. There is no node and no alias for `Pure Love` in the store because there is no page for it to be a name of. Same family as the jjk-set-09 / jjk-set-12 corrections: a phrase the prose uses descriptively was banked as if it were a named technique.

After the three incarnated brothers are introduced, the page says verbatim `The identities of the other six Death Painting Wombs are as follows:` and then gives six bolded Nihongo names with kanji and romaji -- `Noranso` (膿爛相), `Sho-oso` (青瘀相), `Tanso` (噉相), `Sanso` (散相), `Kotsuso` (骨相) and `Shoso` (焼相) -- cited to Chapter 144. The six were named in the manga after this question's premise was written; the six have no pages of their own and so no nodes in the store, which is why nothing in the structural tables contradicted the old gold. The bank also already knew this: `jjk-set-19` was verified against the same page on 2026-08-15 and golds all nine. Two questions on one page cannot answer three and nine, and the page says nine.

questions.question: Who are the notable members of the Zenin Family?
questions.subject: Zenin Family
questions.note: Added 2026-08-15 by the bank expansion. Shape `group`. Notable Zenin Family members Gold corrected 2026-08-15 from `Sorcerer Clan`: the wiki lists 11 members and the bank had 8; added Toji Fushiguro, Jinichi Zenin, Ranta Zenin, Chojuro Zenin, Nobuaki Zenin. Corrected 2026-08-16: `Touji Fushiguro` and `Toji Fushiguro` were both listed, one person counted twice. The wiki's page is `Toji Fushiguro` and `Touji Fushiguro` does not exist, so the duplicate is removed rather than aliased -- an alias would let two gold items resolve to one returned member and inflate recall. Corrected 2026-08-17: `Noritoshi Kamo` removed. He is a member of a different one of the Big Three Families, and the wiki files him there structurally, not narratively. The cited `Sorcerer Clan` page is a tabber; its Zenin tab's `====Members====` table holds exactly eleven rows -- Naobito, Naoya, Ogi, Maki, Mai, Toji Fushiguro, Megumi Fushiguro, Jinichi, Ranta, Chojuro, Nobuaki -- and Noritoshi Kamo appears instead in the same page's Kamo tab Members table, described there as the clan's heir through `Blood Manipulation`. The sub-page `Sorcerer Clan/Zenin Clan` agrees: its `==Members==` gallery lists the same nine plus Toji and Maki under `Outcasts`, and the only sentence on the whole page that mentions Noritoshi calls him `the heir of the Kamo Clan`, cited as the reason killing Megumi would cost the Zenin standing. His own page carries `Category:Kamo Family` and no Zenin category, infobox `affiliation = Kyoto Jujutsu High / Kamo Clan (Formerly)`, and infobox `occupation` including `Heir of the Kamo Clan`. The only Zenin-categorised page his name appears on is the battle `Maki Zenin & Noritoshi Kamo vs. Naoya Zenin`, which carries that category for Maki and Naoya. The gold over-claimed at 12; the wiki supports 11, which is what the engine returns.
